headers.comment: Default: always revalidate. HTML, RSS, the sitemap, and search-index.json all change when content changes, and none of them are content-hashed.
Everything Astro emits under /_astro/ is content-hashed, including fonts, so it can be cached forever. Later rules override earlier ones.
Icons and the social card are stable names, so cache them for a day rather than forever — they can change without a new filename.
